newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 11.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Cooperation between Hong Kong and Shanghai in the financial industry has developed quickly in the recent years with more than 20 Hong Kong banks having opened branches or representative offices in Shanghai.

- The 10-year bond that matures in June 2000, the first China treasury debt that pays interest on an annual basis, will make its first year interest payment on June 16. The Finance Ministry issued a notice on methods of receiving payment.
- A survey shows recent speculation in new domestic share issues has made many investors lose money.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai has launched a campaign to educate residents to properly use and respect local currency notes to ensure longer usage.
